wins.label: Strong revenue growth across all business segments
wins.evidence: With adjusted revenues up 7%, we delivered positive operating leverage in every 1 of our 5 businesses as well as the firm overall for the second straight year.

wins.label: Improved returns and RoTCE
wins.evidence: For the full year, our returns improved to 8.8%, a 180 basis point improvement after adjusting for Banamex and Russia.

wins.label: Significant capital return to shareholders
wins.evidence: We ended the year with a CET1 ratio of 13.2%, which is 160 basis points above our regulatory capital requirement.

wins.label: Transformation progress and efficiency gains
wins.evidence: Over 80% of our programs are now at or nearly at our target state.

wins.label: Positive outlook for 2026
wins.evidence: We expect NII ex-Markets to be up between 5% and 6% in 2026.

risks.label: Regulatory uncertainty
risks.evidence: The timing is up to the regulators. Getting the work completed is just the beginning of the end, as it were.

risks.label: Market volatility
risks.evidence: The global economy has powered through many shocks over the past few years, creating optimism and confidence that economic growth is poised to continue.

risks.label: Credit risk
risks.evidence: Our reserves continue to incorporate an 8-quarter weighted average unemployment rate of 5.2%, which includes a downside scenario average unemployment rate of nearly 7%.

risks.label: Expense management challenges
risks.evidence: Expenses of $13.8 billion were up 6%, driven by increases in compensation and benefits, tax charges, legal expenses as well as technology.

risks.label: Competition in investment banking
risks.evidence: There is a gap between Citi and best-in-class peers when we think about investment banking, capital markets, et cetera.

wins.label: Strong Financial Performance
wins.evidence: We reported net income of $2.5 billion, EPS of $1.19 and an RoTCE of 5.1% on $19.9 billion of revenues, generating positive operating leverage for the majority of our 5 businesses.

wins.label: Improved Returns
wins.evidence: Our returns improved to 8.8%, a 180 basis point improvement after adjusting for Banamex and Russia, and adjusted net income surpassed $16 billion.

wins.label: Positive Operating Leverage
wins.evidence: We delivered positive operating leverage in every 1 of our 5 businesses as well as the firm overall for the second straight year.

wins.label: Record Revenues
wins.evidence: Each business had record revenues and improved their returns by between 250 and 800 basis points.

wins.label: Services Performance
wins.evidence: Services continued to deliver with revenues up 8% and an RoTCE of over 28% for the year.

risks.label: Macroeconomic Uncertainty
risks.evidence: Turning to the macro. The global economy has powered through many shocks over the past few years, creating optimism and confidence that economic growth is poised to continue.

risks.label: Market Volatility
risks.evidence: Fixed income revenues were down 1% despite a challenging year for us in commodities.

risks.label: Competition in Wealth Management
risks.evidence: Net new investment asset flows slowed to $7.2 billion in the quarter, consistent with typical seasonality.

risks.label: Potential for Rate Cuts
risks.evidence: With inflation now at normal levels globally, almost every central bank is becoming more accommodating.

risks.label: China Economic Slowdown
risks.evidence: China's relying on exports to grow and compensate for slower domestic consumer demand.
